Email: liufujun1981@126.com Thanks: 2 Scho
arxiv-1609-06098.creator: Fu-jun Liu 1, Zhong-qing Wang 2, Hui-yuan Li 3
arxiv-1609-06098.description: Abstract . A fully diagonalized spectral method using generalized Laguerre functions is proposed and analyzed for solving elliptic equations on the half line. We first define the generalized Laguerre functions which are complete and mutually orthogonal with respect to an equivalent Sobolev inner product.

arxiv-2106-01861.title: Separated-Spectral-Distribution Estimation Based on Bayesian Inference with Single RGB Camera
arxiv-2106-01861.creator: Yuma Kinoshita, Hitoshi Kiya
arxiv-2106-01861.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a novel method for separately estimating spectral distributions from images captured by a typical RGB camera. The proposed method allows us to separately estimate a spectral distribution of illumination, reflectance, or camera sensitivity, while recent hyperspectral cameras are limited to capturing a joint spectral distribution from a scene.

arxiv-2108-06736.title: Two Applications of Graph Minor Reduction
arxiv-2108-06736.creator: Ghurumuruhan Ganesan
arxiv-2108-06736.description: Abstract In this paper, we study two applications of graph minor reduction. In the first part of the paper, we introduce a variant of the boxicity, called strong boxicity, where the rectangular representation satisfies an additional condition that each rectangle contains at least one point not present in any other rectangle.

arxiv-2305-14826.title: Building Transportation Foundation Model via Generative Graph Transformer
arxiv-2305-14826.creator: Xuhong Wang, Ding Wang, Liang Chen, Yilun Lin, Member, IEEE
arxiv-2305-14826.description: Abstract Efficient traffic management is crucial for maintaining urban mobility, especially in densely populated areas where congestion, accidents, and delays can lead to frustrating and expensive commutes. However, existing prediction methods face challenges in terms of optimizing a single objective and understanding the complex composition of the transportation system.

arxiv-2306-03771.title: Bayesian meta-analysis for evaluating treatment effectiveness in biomarker subgroups using trials of mixed patient populations
arxiv-2306-03771.creator: Lorna Wheaton, Dan Jackson, Sylwia Bujkiewicz
arxiv-2306-03771.description: Abstract Abstract During drug development, evidence can emerge to suggest a treatment is more efficacious in a specific subgroup of patients. Whilst early trials may be conducted in biomarker-mixed populations, later trials are more likely to be conducted in biomarker-positive patients alone, thus leading to trials of the same treatment investigated in different populations.

arxiv-2311-00550.title: Thermal superpotential in designer gravity
arxiv-2311-00550.creator: David Choque, Raúl Rojas
arxiv-2311-00550.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by David Choque, Raúl Rojas. This study focuses on thermal superpotentials in asymptotically anti-de Sitter spacetimes. We study the thermal superpotential and its use as a counterterm for the renormalization of the gravitational action in designer AdS theories with a self-interacting scalar field. Our findings, which are consistent with prior works, demonstrate that, for the thermal superpotential to be a suitable counterterm, it must have some specific form.

arxiv-2409-15534.creator: Maxim Braverman, Ahmad Reza Haj Saeedi Sadegh
arxiv-2409-15534.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Maxim Braverman, Ahmad Reza Haj Saeedi Sadegh. arxiv-2510-09293.description: Abstract Sentence embedding methods have made remarkable progress, yet they still struggle to capture the implicit semantics within sentences. This can be attributed to the inherent limitations of conventional sentence embedding methods that assign only a single vector per sentence.

pmc-13292395.title: A Unified Analytical Method Greenness Score (uAMGS) Quantifies How Microscopic Imaging Is Greener Than Conventional Liquid Chromatography
pmc-13292395.creator: Kotomi Inaba, Ricardo Monge Neria, Rachel A. Saylor, Lydia Kisley
pmc-13292395.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Green chemistry is a set of principles for assessing, developing, and implementing methods that are safer, more efficient, and less detrimental to the environment. The analytical method greenness score (AMGS) is one of many metrics that attempt to evaluate traditional liquid chromatography (LC) based on the energy consumption of the instrument and the safety, health risks, and environmental impact of the solvents employed.

pmc-13415244.title: The Genetic Transformation Mechanism and Application of Plant Hairy Roots
pmc-13415244.creator: Haolin Liu, Zhengyang Zhang, Guangya Bian, Ping Li
pmc-13415244.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Innovation in plant-breeding technology relies on precise, targeted genetic manipulation, which depends on the efficient delivery of genetic elements and robust plant cell regeneration systems. Agrobacterium tumefaciens, a traditional medium for genetic material delivery, is well established and has become widely adopted, but it faces limitations such as species specificity, transformation chimerism, and the requirement for two-step processes of transformation and regeneration. In contrast, Rhizobium rhizogenes can deliver genetic material with efficiency comparable to that of A.

pmc-13583271.title: A Comparative Analysis of the Determinants of Male, Female, and Total Life Expectancy in United States and China
pmc-13583271.creator: Chengdi Qiu, Yao Xie, Chun Jin, Tian Liu
pmc-13583271.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Health is wealth, and ensuring healthy lives and promoting well-being for all are fundamental to achieving Sustainable Development Goal 3 (SDG-3) and fostering sustainable socioeconomic development. Previous studies have primarily examined the economic, social, or institutional determinants of life expectancy (LE) in isolation, with limited attention given to their combined effects within a comprehensive analytical framework for China and United States. To address this gap, the present study investigates the determinants of LE by integrating environmental, economic, social, and institutional factors.

uslaw-usc-t25-s25.title: 25 U.S.C. § 25 — Superintendent for Five Civilized Tribes
uslaw-usc-t25-s25.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s25.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 2 (Officers Of Indian Affairs). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The offices of the Commissioner of the Five Civilized Tribes and superintendent of Union Agency, in Oklahoma, are abolished as of September 1, 1914, and in lieu thereof there shall be appointed by the President, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate.
